What We Do

Decorating services, done properly

From a single bedroom to a whole house, every job starts with thorough preparation and ends with a finish that is checked, touched up and left clean.

Interior Painting

Walls, ceilings and woodwork painted with care — smooth coverage, crisp lines and colours that bring a room together.

Enquire

Exterior Painting

Masonry, render and exterior woodwork prepared and painted to protect your home and lift its kerb appeal.

Enquire

Wallpaper Hanging

Feature walls and full rooms hung with precision — pattern-matched, bubble-free and finished to a sharp edge.

Enquire

Residential Decorating

Whole-home decorating for houses and flats, planned room by room so your home stays liveable while the work is under way.

Enquire

Woodwork & Finishing

Skirting, doors, banisters and trim sanded, filled and finished for that sharp, just-decorated look throughout.

Wall Preparation

Why Choose Us

A finish is only as good as the work beneath it

  • 01

    Preparation first

    Surfaces are filled, sanded and primed before a brush touches them — because a beautiful finish starts long before the paint.

  • 02

    Clean, tidy workmanship

    Floors and furniture are protected, dust is kept down, and every room is left clean and ready to enjoy at the end of the day.

  • 03

    Quality finishes

    Quality paints and materials, applied in proper coats — never rushed, never thinned out to save time.

  • 04

About

One decorator, personally accountable for every finish

Shaun Painting & Decorating is a sole-trader decorating business based in Trowbridge. When you make an enquiry, you deal directly with Shaun — the same person who visits to quote, carries out the work and checks the finished result with you.

That means no hand-offs, no surprises and no corners cut: careful preparation, tidy working and a finish that is judged by one simple standard — whether it looks right in your home, in your light, every day.

How It Works
